with machine/usb/control/request as UsbControlRequest
with machine/usb/control/result as UsbControlResult
with machine/usb/endpoint-read/request as UsbEndpointReadRequest
with machine/usb/endpoint-read/result as UsbEndpointReadResult
with machine/usb/endpoint-write/request as UsbEndpointWriteRequest
with machine/usb/endpoint-write/result as UsbEndpointWriteResult
with flow/zip/feedback/paired as CdcSerialPair
with flow/zip/finite/paired as CdcSerialControlPair
# Ordered duplex serial octets. No Unicode, line discipline, device, USB,
# address, line coding, clock or authority is selected by these values.
type SerialTransmit = {
    bytes: Bytes <= 2048B
}
type SerialReceive = {
    maximum: U64
}
type SerialDuplexRequest =
    transmit SerialTransmit
    | receive SerialReceive
# Ordinal counts requests in one admitted provider lifetime, across both
# directions. Partial actual extents remain observations, never implicit retries.
type SerialTransmitted = {
    ordinal: U64
    requested: U64
    actual: U64
}
type SerialReceived = {
    ordinal: U64
    requested: U64
    actual: U64
    short: Boolean
    bytes: Bytes <= 2048B
}
type SerialDuplexResult =
    transmitted SerialTransmitted
    | received SerialReceived
    | stalled
    | provider-lost
    | unsupported
    | timeout

# A finite, setup-once CDC realization of generic duplex serial octets.
type CdcAcmDescriptorSupported = {
    supported: Boolean
}
type CdcSerialControl = {
    result: UsbControlResult
    descriptor: Boolean
    set-coding: Boolean
    coding: Boolean
    ack: Boolean
}
type CdcSerialEvent =
    closed
    | serial SerialDuplexResult
    | command SerialDuplexRequest
    | control CdcSerialControl
    | write UsbEndpointWriteResult
    | read UsbEndpointReadResult
type CdcSerialState = {
    request: SerialDuplexRequest
    phase: U64
    operations: U64
    reads: U64
    terminal: Boolean
}
type CdcSerialRoute =
    ready CdcSerialState
    | control CdcSerialState
    | write CdcSerialState
    | read CdcSerialState
    | stopped CdcSerialState
type CdcSerialPending =
    running CdcSerialState
    | stopped
type CdcSerialTransition = {
    previous: CdcSerialState
    event: CdcSerialEvent
    accepted: Boolean
}
type CdcSerialEmission =
    emit SerialDuplexResult
    | absent

# Descriptive Root-selected geometry is information, never possession or grants.
# The configuration is an actual frozen standard-descriptor completion.
type UsbDiscoveryGeometry = {
    address: U64
    epoch: U64
    interval: U64
    packet: U64
    transfer: U64
}
type UsbDiscoverySelection =
    absent
    | selected UsbDiscoveryGeometry
type UsbProtocolDiscovery = {
    attachment: U64
    configuration: UsbControlResult
    read: UsbDiscoverySelection
    write: UsbDiscoverySelection
}

# The pure finite join completes after both immutable observations close.

# Pin the complete 67-byte first-profile descriptor, including CDC Header,
# Call Management, ACM and Union records, comm0/data1 and bulk81/02 max64.
# Notification83 is recognized but unconsumed: unsolicited notification policy
# is unsupported by this first control+bulk profile; no IRQ provider is selected.
type CdcAcmTopologyObservation = {
    completion: UsbControlResult
    selections: Boolean
}

plot cdc-acm-no-data-ack (
    completion: UsbControlResult...| >> supported: Boolean...|
) = (!(. is completed) ? false : (.completed.transferred == 0 && !.completed.short && sequence/length(.completed.input) == 0))

plot cdc-acm-line-coding-ack (
    completion: UsbControlResult...| >> supported: Boolean...|
) = (!(. is completed) ? false : (.completed.transferred != 7 || .completed.short || sequence/length(.completed.input) != 7 ? false : (sequence/at(.completed.input, 0) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 1) == 194 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 2) == 1 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 3) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 4) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 5) == 0 && sequence/at(.completed.input, 6) == 8)))


# Pure Root preflight and the class Back share the SAME checked topology law.
# Descriptive geometry is checked here; it creates no native authority.
plot cdc-serial-root-topology-observation (
    discovery: UsbProtocolDiscovery...| >> observation: CdcAcmTopologyObservation...|
) = ({ completion: .configuration, selections: (.attachment == 0 || !(.read is selected) || !(.write is selected) ? false : ((.read.selected.address == 129 && .read.selected.transfer == 2 && .read.selected.packet == 64 && .read.selected.interval == 0 && .read.selected.epoch > 0) && (.write.selected.address == 2 && .write.selected.transfer == 2 && .write.selected.packet == 64 && .write.selected.interval == 0 && .write.selected.epoch > 0))) })
# The certified class path consumes an already accepted Root handoff. Native
# class completion remains untouched; this is a pure policy observation.
plot cdc-serial-class-topology-observation (
    completion: UsbControlResult...| >> observation: CdcAcmTopologyObservation...|
) = ({ completion: ., selections: true })
plot cdc-serial-profile-preflight (
    >> discovery: UsbProtocolDiscovery...|
    supported: Boolean...| >>
) {
    discovery >> cdc-serial-root-topology-observation() >> cdc-acm-topology-supported() >> supported
}

plot cdc-serial-closed (
    start: Text >> event: CdcSerialEvent
) = (closed(empty))
plot cdc-serial-start (
    start: CdcSerialEvent...| >> state: CdcSerialState...|
) = ({ request: receive({ maximum: 64 }), phase: 0, operations: 0, reads: 0, terminal: false })
plot cdc-serial-route (
    state: CdcSerialState...| >> route: CdcSerialRoute...|
) = (.phase == 9 ? ready(.) : (.terminal || .phase > 8 || .operations > 32 ? stopped(.) : (.phase == 0 || .phase == 8 ? ready(.) : (.phase <= 5 ? control(.) : (.phase == 6 ? write(.) : read(.))))))
plot cdc-serial-pending (
    route: CdcSerialRoute...| >> pending: CdcSerialPending...|
) = (. is stopped ? stopped(empty) : (. is ready ? running(.ready) : (. is control ? running(.control) : (. is write ? running(.write) : running(.read)))))
plot cdc-serial-command (
    request: SerialDuplexRequest...| >> event: CdcSerialEvent...|
) = (command(.))
plot cdc-serial-command-event (
    pair: CdcSerialPair...| >> event: CdcSerialEvent...|
) = (.1)
plot cdc-serial-control-request (
    state: CdcSerialState...| >> request: UsbControlRequest...|
) = (.phase == 1 ? { setup: 0x0043000002000680, output: [] } : (.phase == 2 ? { setup: 0x0000000000010900, output: [] } : (.phase == 3 ? { setup: 0x0007000000002021, output: [0, 194, 1, 0, 0, 0, 8] } : (.phase == 4 ? { setup: 0x00070000000021a1, output: [] } : { setup: 0x0000000000032221, output: [] }))))
plot cdc-serial-write-request (
    state: CdcSerialState...| >> request: UsbEndpointWriteRequest...|
) = ({ wire: .request.transmit.bytes })
plot cdc-serial-read-request (
    state: CdcSerialState...| >> request: UsbEndpointReadRequest...|
) = ({ length: .request.receive.maximum })
plot cdc-serial-descriptor-flag (
    supported: Boolean...| >> flag: CdcAcmDescriptorSupported...| <= 256B
) = ({ supported: . })
plot cdc-serial-control-event (
    pair: CdcSerialControlPair...| >> event: CdcSerialEvent...|
) = (control({ result: .0, descriptor: .1.supported, set-coding: !(.0 is completed) ? false : (.0.completed.transferred == 7 && !.0.completed.short && sequence/length(.0.completed.input) == 0), coding: !(.0 is completed) ? false : (.0.completed.transferred != 7 || .0.completed.short || sequence/length(.0.completed.input) != 7 ? false : (((sequence/at(.0.completed.input, 0) == 0 && (sequence/at(.0.completed.input, 1) == 194 && sequence/at(.0.completed.input, 2) == 1)) && ((sequence/at(.0.completed.input, 3) == 0 && sequence/at(.0.completed.input, 4) == 0) && (sequence/at(.0.completed.input, 5) == 0 && sequence/at(.0.completed.input, 6) == 8))))), ack: !(.0 is completed) ? false : (.0.completed.transferred == 0 && !.0.completed.short && sequence/length(.0.completed.input) == 0) }))
plot cdc-serial-observe-control (
    >> result: UsbControlResult...| <= 4096B
    event: CdcSerialEvent...| <= 4096B >>
) {
    pair: flow/zip/finite
    result >> pair.left
    result >> cdc-serial-class-topology-observation() >> cdc-acm-topology-supported() >> cdc-serial-descriptor-flag() >> pair.right
    pair.paired >> cdc-serial-control-event() >> event
}
plot cdc-serial-write-event (
    result: UsbEndpointWriteResult...| >> event: CdcSerialEvent...|
) = (write(.))
plot cdc-serial-read-event (
    result: UsbEndpointReadResult...| >> event: CdcSerialEvent...|
) = (read(.))
plot cdc-serial-accept (
    pair: CdcSerialPair...| >> transition: CdcSerialTransition...|
) = ({ previous: .0, event: .1, accepted: .0.phase == 9 ? (.1 is closed) : (.0.terminal || .0.operations > 32 || .0.phase > 8 ? false : (.0.phase == 0 || .0.phase == 8 ? (.1 is closed ? true : (.1 is command && .0.operations < 32 ? (.1.command is transmit ? bytes/length(.1.command.transmit.bytes) <= 64 : (.1.command.receive.maximum > 0 && .1.command.receive.maximum <= 64)) : false)) : (.0.phase <= 5 ? (.1 is control ? (.0.phase == 1 ? .1.control.descriptor : (.0.phase == 3 ? .1.control.set-coding : (.0.phase == 4 ? .1.control.coding : .1.control.ack))) : false) : (.0.phase == 6 ? (.1 is write ? (.1.write is completed ? .1.write.completed.actual <= bytes/length(.0.request.transmit.bytes) : false) : false) : (.1 is read ? (.1.read is completed ? (.1.read.completed.ordinal == .0.reads && .1.read.completed.actual <= .0.request.receive.maximum && .1.read.completed.actual == bytes/length(.1.read.completed.wire) && .1.read.completed.short == (.1.read.completed.actual < .0.request.receive.maximum)) : false) : false))))) })
plot cdc-serial-advance (
    transition: CdcSerialTransition...| >> next: CdcSerialState...|
) = ({ request: .accepted && .event is command && (.previous.phase == 0 || .previous.phase == 8) ? .event.command : .previous.request, phase: .event is closed ? 10 : (!.accepted || .previous.phase == 9 ? 9 : (.previous.phase == 0 ? 1 : (.previous.phase == 8 || .previous.phase == 5 ? ((.previous.phase == 8 ? .event.command : .previous.request) is transmit ? 6 : 7) : (.previous.phase < 5 ? .previous.phase + 1 : 8)))), operations: .accepted && (.previous.phase == 6 || .previous.phase == 7) && .previous.operations < 32 ? .previous.operations + 1 : .previous.operations, reads: .accepted && .previous.phase == 7 && .previous.reads < 32 ? .previous.reads + 1 : .previous.reads, terminal: .event is closed })
plot cdc-serial-emission (
    transition: CdcSerialTransition...| >> emission: CdcSerialEmission...|
) = (.previous.phase == 9 ? absent(empty) : (.accepted ? (.previous.phase == 6 ? emit(transmitted({ ordinal: .previous.operations, requested: bytes/length(.previous.request.transmit.bytes), actual: .event.write.completed.actual })) : (.previous.phase == 7 ? emit(received({ ordinal: .previous.operations, requested: .previous.request.receive.maximum, actual: .event.read.completed.actual, short: .event.read.completed.short, bytes: .event.read.completed.wire })) : absent(empty))) : emit(.event is closed ? unsupported(empty) : (.event is serial ? unsupported(empty) : (.event is command ? unsupported(empty) : (.event is control ? (.event.control.result is stalled ? stalled(empty) : (.event.control.result is provider-lost ? provider-lost(empty) : unsupported(empty))) : (.event is write ? (.event.write is stalled ? stalled(empty) : (.event.write is provider-lost ? provider-lost(empty) : unsupported(empty))) : (.event.read is stalled ? stalled(empty) : (.event.read is provider-lost ? provider-lost(empty) : (.event.read is timeout ? timeout(empty) : unsupported(empty)))))))))))

# Phase9 drains remaining bounded command/closing events after one terminal
# result. The seeded-until terminal flag stays false until closure is drained.
# It selects no physical effects and emits no duplicate result. Phase10
# follows the single closing event. Normal closure also enters phase10 directly.
# Genuine one semantic request per corresponding result; no synthetic repeated
# transmissions. This first bounded profile supports at most32 operations.
# Root must select this checked Plot Back exactly, admit its USB subordinate
# calls and storage, and supply a reviewed bounded producer/consumer.
# Ordered concat appends exactly one closing event after the request Flow.
# The readiness feedback gate observes it after the final physical completion.
plot cdc-serial-provider (
    request: SerialDuplexRequest...| <= 4096B >> result: SerialDuplexResult...| <= 4096B
) {
    singleton: flow/singleton
    cell: state/seeded/flow/until
    route: cdc-serial-route()
    join: flow/zip/feedback
    commands: flow/zip/feedback
    requests: flow/concat/finite
    events: flow/merge/finite
    transport-events: flow/merge/finite
    bulk-events: flow/merge/finite
    control: machine/usb/control
    observe-control: cdc-serial-observe-control
    write: machine/usb/endpoint-write
    read: machine/usb/endpoint-read
    "start" >> cdc-serial-closed() >> singleton.value
    singleton.flow >> cdc-serial-start() >> cell.seed
    singleton.flow >> requests.right
    request >> cdc-serial-command() >> requests.left
    requests.concatenated >> commands.right
    cell.current >> route
    route >> cdc-serial-pending() >> select(CdcSerialPending.running, unmatched=drop) >> join.left
    route >> select(CdcSerialRoute.ready, unmatched=drop) >> commands.left
    commands.paired >> cdc-serial-command-event() >> events.left
    route >> select(CdcSerialRoute.control, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-serial-control-request() >> control.request
    route >> select(CdcSerialRoute.write, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-serial-write-request() >> write.request
    route >> select(CdcSerialRoute.read, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-serial-read-request() >> read.request
    control.result >> observe-control.result
    observe-control.event >> transport-events.left
    write.result >> cdc-serial-write-event() >> bulk-events.left
    read.result >> cdc-serial-read-event() >> bulk-events.right
    bulk-events.merged >> transport-events.right
    transport-events.merged >> events.right
    events.merged >> join.right
    join.paired >> cdc-serial-accept() >> cdc-serial-advance() >> cell.next
    join.paired >> cdc-serial-accept() >> cdc-serial-emission() >> select(CdcSerialEmission.emit, unmatched=drop) >> result
}

# Reviewable bounded semantic producer: explicitly request sixteen transmissions
# of the admitted seed and sixteen receives. The CDC Back never invents these.
plot cdc-serial-producer-start (
    seed: SerialDuplexRequest...| >> state: CdcSerialState...|
) = ({ request: ., phase: 0, operations: 0, reads: 0, terminal: !(. is transmit) ? true : bytes/length(.transmit.bytes) > 64 })
plot cdc-serial-producer-route (
    state: CdcSerialState...| >> route: CdcSerialPending...|
) = (.terminal || .operations >= 32 ? stopped(empty) : running(.))
plot cdc-serial-producer-request (
    state: CdcSerialState...| >> request: SerialDuplexRequest...|
) = (.operations % 2 == 0 ? .request : receive({ maximum: 64 }))
plot cdc-serial-producer-result-event (
    result: SerialDuplexResult...| >> event: CdcSerialEvent...|
) = (serial(.))
plot cdc-serial-producer-next (
    pair: CdcSerialPair...| >> state: CdcSerialState...|
) = ({ request: .0.request, phase: 0, reads: 0, operations: .0.operations < 32 ? .0.operations + 1 : .0.operations, terminal: .0.terminal || .0.operations >= 31 || !(.1 is serial) ? true : (.0.operations % 2 == 0 ? (.1.serial is transmitted ? (.1.serial.transmitted.ordinal != .0.operations || .1.serial.transmitted.requested != bytes/length(.0.request.transmit.bytes) || .1.serial.transmitted.actual != .1.serial.transmitted.requested) : true) : (.1.serial is received ? (.1.serial.received.ordinal != .0.operations || .1.serial.received.requested != 64 || .1.serial.received.actual > 64 || .1.serial.received.actual != bytes/length(.1.serial.received.bytes) || .1.serial.received.short != (.1.serial.received.actual < 64)) : true)) })
# This consumer preserves typed observations and opaque octets; it does not
# claim these serial bytes are text or implicitly apply UTF8/framing/TTY policy.
plot cdc-serial-consumer (
    result: SerialDuplexResult...| >> observation: SerialDuplexResult...|
) = (.)
plot cdc-serial-duplex-demonstration (
    >> seed: SerialDuplexRequest...|
    observation: SerialDuplexResult...| >>
) {
    producer: state/seeded/flow/until
    join: flow/zip/feedback
    provider: serial/duplex-bytes
    seed >> cdc-serial-producer-start() >> producer.seed
    producer.current >> cdc-serial-producer-route() >> select(CdcSerialPending.running, unmatched=drop) >> cdc-serial-producer-request() >> provider.request
    producer.current >> cdc-serial-producer-route() >> select(CdcSerialPending.running, unmatched=drop) >> join.left
    provider.result >> cdc-serial-producer-result-event() >> join.right
    provider.result >> cdc-serial-consumer() >> observation
    join.paired >> cdc-serial-producer-next() >> producer.next
}
